principle_text: When the persuadee reveals financial difficulties, avoid pressing for increased donations and instead focus on building rapport and understanding their situation.
When the persuadee shares financial difficulties, avoid focusing solely on shared hardship without guiding the conversation toward positive reasons to donate.
When the persuadee expresses financial hardship and life challenges, avoid only showing empathy without guiding the conversation toward actionable donation encouragement.
When the persuadee shares detailed personal struggles, avoid generic acknowledgments that do not guide the conversation toward donation or deeper engagement.
When the persuadee shares extensive details about their busy schedule and personal challenges, avoid making minimal acknowledgments that do not connect to donation motivation or empathy.
When the persuadee shares personal hardships, avoid shifting focus to unrelated personal information that does not acknowledge their concerns or advance the donation conversation.
When the persuadee shares personal hardships about themselves or loved ones, avoid making comments that only acknowledge difficulties without linking back to the charitable cause or donation appeal.
